retained_deployment_artifact.description: The deployment archive is retained privately. Its 497 public asset files are copied byte for byte into site/ and compared with freshly fetched public responses.

provider_stored_archive_metadata.note: Provider metadata only. Stored TAR bytes were not retrieved. The local gzip container has its own independently recorded hash.

timestamp_target: The release asset SHA256SUMS-public.txt binds the explicit public ZIP. Its OpenTimestamps receipt is supplied as a separate release asset.

chronology: Capture times are local observations. GitHub immutable-release attestation and the OpenTimestamps receipt are separately verifiable archival evidence. Consult their recorded verification status for the available proof.
